title: Restaurants in Mallworld
content: I just woke up from a mallworld dream. It was a pretty involved one at a specific area I end up in a lot. It seems to take all day to travel to this place by what I think is a train, or maybe something like an airplane but used more casually in mallworld. Regardless, the first thing I do when I wind up in this area (this time and previously) is find the combination Mexican restaurant and American/Greek style diner near the train station. This sort of straddles the space between two busy streets. I would say around 70% of it is a table service diner of the type you find in the northeastern US, with an entrance on one of the streets that goes right up to the sidewalk. The building is split longways (parallel to the two streets) and the other half of it is a small counter service taqueria with it's own entrance. This half doesn't go up to the other street but has a parking lot in front. From the Mexican restaurant side it sort of resembles a strip mall, where there are more shops past it on one end under a covered walkway. The restaurants are connected internally at the middle so you can look into each from the other (near the Mexican place order counter/diner host station) and the employees of the diner seem to run the Mexican place on the side. I typically enter through the Mexican restaurant. They serve street style tacos and, crazily, the chili cheese burritos Taco Bell used to sell. This is their specialty and they're well loved in this area for it. This is sort of a touristy area and the chili cheese burritos are considered by the employees as being for the gringo tourists. Today I ordered a few tacos and a chili cheese burrito but they forgot my burrito and before I could mention it word spread around the busy place that there was a guy who locked himself into the bathroom of the diner side and was doing something threatening. Like a hostage or bomb type situation. So I got out taking my tacos with me and watched from the street as the guy was apprehended. After that and some other stuff I went to my intended destination which was like a junk shop primarily selling/trading all kinds of tools. The owner lamented a guy had just ripped him off by misrepresenting something he was trading and then tried to get me into some kind of cryptocurrency "opportunity" (scam). The crazy thing is I saw stuff in this place that I remember bringing to him previous visits. As usual for mallworld there were products that don't exist alongside ones that do, what sticks out is a set of two metal dinosaur toys in a blister pack with what looked like male "N" type connectors on the back but with a much larger center pin. You hooked these up to some apparatus and they breathe small jets of real fire. Another reoccurring restaurant for me is in an entirely different area, it's an old style Cantonese Chinese place, the kind where there's an area with hanging roasted ducks behind glass and a somewhat classy dining area. This one is actually a front for something if you enter a specific area of it and I'm usually trying to find it in the dreams where it appears. I always wake up when I find it though. Are there any reoccurring restaurants in your mallworlds?
